name: How much does it cost to remove a popcorn ceiling?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remove a popcorn ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to remove a popcorn ceiling varies based on several factors, including the size of the area, the ceiling height, the condition of the existing texture, and whether the popcorn ceiling contains asbestos. Additional costs may arise for repairs to the underlying drywall, texturing, priming, and painting. It's best to obtain a detailed estimate from a professional contractor after an on-site evaluation to get an accurate price for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popcorn ceiling removal costs depend on area size, ceiling height, texture condition, and potential asbestos, plus any necessary repairs and finishing.
